subject: [PATCH v3 1/2] mm: refactor find_next_best_node to find_next_best_node_in

2026-09-23.patch_summary: This patch refactors the find_next_best_node function to make it more flexible by allowing it to take an explicit list of candidate nodes instead of always using the N_MEMORY set. This change enables building fallback lists with non-N_MEMORY candidates, but does not introduce any functional changes as all callers still select from N_MEMORY. The refactor is done in three files: mm/internal.h, mm/memory-tiers.c, and mm/page_alloc.c.
